title: What happens when AI writes better code than humans?

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if AI not only writes better code but also outpaces humans in innovation and problem-solving?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, AI like GitHub Copilot and Codex can generate functional code, but human oversight is still crucial for complex systems and security.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If AI writes better code, who owns the intellectual property? What happens to jobs, and how do we ensure fairness and prevent bias in AI-generated code?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are embedding ethical guidelines, using AI as a tool rather than a replacement, and focusing on human-AI collaboration in development pipelines.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, AI could enable more people to build software with minimal training, democratizing tech innovation and solving global challenges faster.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will balance AI’s power with human values, creating a new era of collaboration and progress in coding and beyond.
